title_zh: 请邻居帮忙查看旧围栏

scenario.label_zh: 协商花园围栏检查与修补
scenario.goal_zh: 商定查看松动围栏并优先考虑修补和避开鸟巢。

context_zh: 邻居讨论旧木围栏松动的问题，希望避免不必要的更换和干扰。
author: author-phase05-b

sentences.speaker: Poppy
sentences.text: Could you do me a favour and look at the fence with me? One panel is loose.

sentences.speaker: Gareth
sentences.text: Yes. Were you planning to replace the whole thing?

sentences.speaker: Poppy
sentences.text: Only if we have to. Keeping the sound wood and repairing just the loose panel would reduce the environmental impact.

sentences.speaker: Gareth
sentences.text: Let us check the loose section first. Is that a bird nest in the hedge behind it?

sentences.speaker: Poppy
sentences.text: It is. I would rather leave that area alone for now.

sentences.speaker: Gareth
sentences.text: Then we can look from the path without moving the hedge, and ask a professional about the damaged panel.

sentences.speaker: Poppy
sentences.text: That suits me. Let us inspect it from this side and make a note of what needs attention.
